raw_segments.text: With finger-pointed and eye-leveled at the pequod, the beggar-like stranger stood a moment,
as if in a troubled reverie, then starting a little, turned and said,
Ye have shipped, have ye, names down on the papers.
Well, well, what signed is signed, and what's to be will be, and then again, perhaps it
Anyhow, it's all fixed and arranged already, and some sailors or other must go with him,
I suppose, as well these as any other men, God-pity him.
Morning to ye, shipmates morning, the ineffable heavens bless ye, I'm sorry I stopped ye.
